newsitem.title: USA: Intertek Finance Plc issues $203 mln 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Intertek Finance Plc issues $203 mln 144A debt.

text.p: The following rule 144a private placement debt issue from Intertek Finance Plc was priced on Thursday, said a high-yield syndicate source.
The issue was increased in size by $13 million and was said to be several times oversubscribed.
BT Securities Corp is lead manager on the deal.
